answer: Require every agent identity to post a time-locked stake before it can earn, with the stake slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicate identities. A cheap fake is like trying to cross a canyon on a rope bridge made of paper: each extra island identity needs its own locked funds and its own verifiable work history, so creating a thousand fakes multiplies the attacker's cost a thousandfold instead of giving free votes. Honest agents that reach the zenith of consistent, useful work keep their stake and reputation, while Sybils bleed capital before they can sway anything.
